class.name: HEGoMultiMeshOutput
class.brief_description: Instances an existing mesh resource once per output point through a [MultiMesh].
class.description: The fetch returns points grouped by output name and then by mesh resource path, so one HDA can drive several [MultiMeshInstance3D]s with a different mesh each.

method.name: point_attribs
method.description: Per-instance attributes this handler reads. Attributes this handler reads off each instanced point: the shared orientation set plus colour. A function rather than a const, because a const cannot be built from another class's constant. See [HEGoPointUtil].

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Whether the cook produced points flagged for multimesh instancing.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the instancing points of the cook and builds the multimeshes.

method.name: setup_multimesh
method.description: Creates a [MultiMeshInstance3D] named [param multimesh_name] under [code]Outputs/[/code] and fills it with one instance per point in [param point_dict].

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Points with this attribute set to 1 are instanced.
Attribute naming the output a point belongs to, and the mesh to instance.
Node name prefix used when an HDA does not name its multimesh output.
